description: The plot titled “BBQ” illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of demonstrations for four methods. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 45, 50, and 55 (units not specified). A dark blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Squared Exponential” starts near 53 at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 55 by around 250 demonstrations, and then stays close to 55 through 1500 demonstrations with small fluctuations. A medium-blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Tanh” begins around 47–48 at 0 demonstrations and remains nearly flat around 48 across the full x-range, with only slight variation at intermediate points. A lighter blue solid line with circular markers labeled “ELU” starts around 46 at 0 demonstrations and stays approximately flat near 46 through 1500 demonstrations. A pink solid line with circular markers labeled “LLaMA2-chat-7B” lies near 41–42 at 0 demonstrations and remains essentially constant at roughly the same level through 1500 demonstrations.
